title: Voices
summary: Some of the story is spoken: cinematics, story cards and radio messages.
text:
Some of the story is **spoken**. The people you meet talk in cinematics, on story cards and over the radio: the Director's briefings from Sol Mission Control, the voices that reach you across space, and more as the story goes on.

Transmissions come in through the static, the way a signal that has crossed light-years should.

A radio message in the corner stays up until it has been said. Closing a card or skipping a cinematic stops the voice. Lines that aren't voiced yet are just text.

To turn voices off, go to **Options → Sound → Voices**.
